text:
maria (PM): Quick thread to nail down scope/priorities for the "Reserve+." We need a lightweight GA that buys deterministic tail behavior for small spikes, but also a clear path for expensive edge cases (cross-region spill, long spikes). want decisions on billing model, fallback ordering, telemetry granularity, and pilot gating.

vikram (Eng): tl;dr: implement a lightweight ReserveManager + routing flag. question: do we guarantee absolute latency numbers or offer a contractual "best-effort with credits"?

maria (PM): preference: SLA on p95, best-effort on p99 with documented fallback penalties and credits. avoids overpromising on long multi-hour incidents.

zoe (Infra): infra constraints: can't hold large idle fleets. suggested approach: ephemeral warm lanes + small pinned KV sets per-tenant while reserve active. need to pick durable identifier for tokens (reservation_id) and TTL semantics.

lee (SRE): ops constraints: fallback must be observable and reversible. propose strict rollback triggers: sustained p99 > 600ms for 5m OR error-rate delta +1.5% sustained 5m. Also require a chaos test during canary.

nina (Finance): billing tradeoffs: three options: (A) flat uplift baked into reservation, (B) pay-as-you-burn minutes, (C) hybrid (small uplift + overage). (A) easiest sales story; (B) less predictable revenue. recommend hybrid for pilots.

anya (Legal): we'll need a "failure modes" appendix in SLA: define ReserveExhaustion, QuantizedFallback, and CrossRegionSpill. Cross-region must be opt-in for private deployments. also propose a cap on total credit liability.

mike (Solutions): customer angle: signal-first customers want a dashboard + webhook for low-reserve warnings. also want the ability to opt-disable cross-region spill but accept quantized fallback.

vikram (Eng): proposed fallback order (configurable by tenant): 1) reserved -> 2) reserve_fastlane (pinned KV) -> 3) quantized_variant (lower-precision model) -> 4) regional_spill -> 5) queued_request / degrade_response. this gives predictable latency increases.

zoe (Infra): technical note: regional_spill adds complexity for data residency and cold-starts. if allowed, we should ensure customers explicitly opt-in and we attach metadata flags to requests for auditing.

lee (SRE): telemetry minimums: per-tenant reserve_used_minutes, reserve_remaining_pct, failover_count, failover_path, failover_added_tail_latency (histogram). need 1m resolution for alerting and 5m for digests. also require an alert when reserve_usage_rate > 75% for 30m.

nina (Finance): for pilot pricing (hybrid) propose: +8% reservation uplift + $0.12/min for consumed reserve minutes beyond included allotment. will simulate ARPU and churn impact.

maria (PM): launch acceptance checklist (MVP):
- ReserveManager + routing flag implemented (ENG)
- Per-tenant metrics emitted and surfaced in Console (INFRA/SRE)
- Pilot pricing & contract addendum (Finance/Legal)
- Canary plan + chaos test (SRE)
- Customer UX: console warnings + webhook (DevEx/Solutions)
- Docs: API, best-practices, and fallback behaviors (DevEx)

vikram (Eng): implementation sketch for ReserveManager config:
```
reserve_plus:
  allocation_mode: percent | token_minutes
  percent: 10
  token_minutes: 25
  fallback_order: [quantized_variant, regional_spill, queue]
  billing: uplift_plus_overage | uplift_only | metered
  telemetry: high_freq | standard
  rollback_triggers:
    p99_ms: 600
    error_rate_pct: 1.5
```

zoe (Infra): infra tasks: add reservation_id tagging for metrics, implement soft-eviction for pinned KV (LRU grace window default 180s), and add a routing hook to smart-router to respect reserve flags. I'll open tickets after this thread.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-5420 "reservation_id tagging + reserve_plus metrics" assigned to eng-infra.

lee (SRE): pilot plan: 2-3 customers; internal canary at 1% traffic for 48h; then staged pilot ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 10% over 72h while monitoring SLOs and failover telemetry. hard cap: pilot must not exceed 3 customers.

maria (PM): risk table (quick):
- Risk: thundering warmup on preemption. Mitigation: soft-evict + warm-pool + KV pinning.
- Risk: billing disputes on consumed minutes. Mitigation: expose minute-level ledger + webhook + invoice-preview in Console.
- Risk: legal/data residency for regional_spill. Mitigation: opt-in + auditing + explicit contract clause.

nina (Finance): pilot commercial asks: require signed addendum that states uplift + overage rate and limits liability. sales must collect consent for cross-region spill.

anya (Legal): drafting addendum and SLA appendix. will include audit fields and credit cap language. target draft by Tue EOD.

mike (Solutions): we'll prepare a customer-facing one-pager explaining fallbacks and recommended settings (prefer quantized_variant before spill).

vikram (Eng): engineering timeline proposal:
- Week 0-1: spec + infra tickets
- Week 2-4: build ReserveManager + routing + KV pin API
- Week 5: internal canary + chaos tests
- Week 6-7: pilot with up to 3 customers
- Week 8: evaluate pilot and go/no-go for GA

zoe (Infra): dependency: need fast path to tag and ingest per-tenant metrics; will prioritize INFRA ticket.

lee (SRE): acceptance metric to pass pilot: no more than 0.5% increase in global error-rate attributable to reserve rollout; per-tenant p99 must meet contractual target for at least 95% of pilot windows.

maria (PM): immediate next steps: vikram + zoe write the ReserveManager spec by EOD Wed; nina posts pilot pricing spreadsheet; anya posts SLA + addendum draft; mike drafts customer one-pager; lee posts canary checklist. scheduling 30m sync Thu AM.

vikram (Eng): ack, will post spec in #product-docs and link here.

zoe (Infra): ack, starting prototype for soft-evict and KV pin today.

lee (SRE): will prepare chaos scenarios and checklist.

maria (PM): thanks team :thumbsup: keeping this thread as the canonical decision record for Reserve+.
